articles.author: MindWave Innovations
articles.headline: MindWave Innovations Signs Agreement with US-Based BlockAssure to Build and Operate AssureChain, an End-to-End Insurance and Reinsurance Network
articles.summary: Apimeds' wholly owned MindWave subsidiary announces a two-year maintenance and services agreement with BlockAssure to build and operate an insurance/reinsurance blockchain subnet. Planned functionality is attributed to the issuer; the release does not establish completed deployment, audited revenue or independently verified insurance coverage.
